Home | Jungle River Lodge | Honduras
top of page
Welcome to Jungle River Lodge
We are Jungle River Lodge, one of the few backpacker-friendly lodges located between two of the largest and most diverse national parks in Honduras. Unlike most other local accommodation, we are located directly on the Rio Cangrejal. The rustic character of the lodge gives it a cosy and homely atmosphere inspired by the surrounding jungle. Whether you want to relax and enjoy doing nothing, watch the wildlife on the rocks or embark on a jungle adventure, Jungle River Lodge will fulfil these desires and provide you with an unforgettable experience.
Stay with Us
Our Mission
We are dedicated to making this unique jungle experience accessible to everyone, from families to budget travellers, whilst ensuring that our local staff are adequately supported.
Surrounded by two National Parks on
the Cangrejal River in Honduras
Jungle River Lodge is located between two of the most beautiful national parks in Honduras: Pico Bonito National Park and Nombre de Dios National Park. These two national parks are separated by the Rio Cangrejal. Pico Bonito National Park in particular is one of the most biodiverse national parks in Central America because it is so large and hosts a variety of climates, ranging from tropical rainforest in the lowlands bordering the coastal plain of Atlantida to tropical cloud forest at altitudes of over 1,800 metres above sea level. The highest peak is Pico Bonito, which is 2,485 metres above sea level and takes about ten days to hike. Pico Bonito is one of the least explored national parks in Honduras, therefore the park remains in its natural state with only a handful of hiking trails. Because of the special landscape it offers, it is home to many special species such as jaguars, armadillos, wild boar, monkeys, toucans, white-tailed deer, mountain lions, river otters and many other species .
Review from Hostelworld
"Jungle River Lodge is picturesque, nestled in a stunning location on the rocks on along the river. We saw many beautiful animals right outside the lodge. The lodge has accommodating and delightful staff. The facilities provided everything we needed, including last minute hiking and rafting. Meals and drinks were amazing, and the room was very comfortable."

"Highly recommend this hostel! The family are so kind and welcoming and make it feel like a home from home in the most incredible setting. They offer a white water rafting tour with canyoning and it was our favourite tour we've done so far in Central America. They also offer meals at a very reasonable price and it was a great to try some traditional Honduran dishes. Honestly do NOT skip this place!"

Dorm Rooms | Jungle River Lodge
top of page
Our Dorms
Jungle River Lodge has two dormitories. Both dormitories have different beautiful aspects that make them individual and unique, forming a budget and comfort dormitory style. Do you want to wake up with a beautiful view of the jungle and river or enjoy more comfort and space? We offer both!
Family Budget Room
​
Jungle-inspired rooms with open windows that reach to the roof and are only closed by mosquito nets. Makes a great view over the jungle mountains and river. It has a bathroom next to the room with a cold water shower.
​
​
Price : USD $59 for two personas and 19.8 5 additional per person (19% taxes included)
Check Availability
Comfort Dorm
Sleeps 17
A spacious and bright room divided into three separate areas. This division makes the rooms seem cosier but still large. There are two bathrooms with cold water showers. The room has lockers for everyone.
​
​
Price: USD 19.85 (19% taxes included)
Check Availability

Private Rooms | Jungle River Lodge
top of page
Our Private Rooms
Jungle River Lodge offers five different types of private rooms for different group sizes. They all have a different jungle-inspired flair that makes each of them special. All rooms have en-suite bathrooms with hot water showers. Fall asleep and wake up to the sound of the jungle and the R o Cangrejal.
Basic Private - Room #5
Sleeps 2
Cute little room with it's own private entrance and open windows that are only closed by mosquito screens. Relax and fall asleep to the sounds of the jungle and the river close by. This room has a comfortable double bed and an en-suite bathroom with a large, hot water shower. Sheets, pillows, power outlets, a floor fan, good wifi, soap, face towels, towels and bath mat are found in the room. Blanket available upon request.
​
Price: USD 49.95
The price includes 19% tax. Meals and tours available for an addition cost.

Blanket available upon request.

Location | Jungle River Lodge
top of page
Our Location
We are located at Km 7, Careterra a Yaruca, 30 minutes from the centre of La Ceiba or 45 minutes from the ferry port of Utila and Roatan. There are several ways to get to us and back to La Ceiba:
By Private transport
Let us know in advance so we can arrange private transport for you.
They charge 500 Lps from the ferry, 600 - 800 Lps from downtown La Ceiba and 800 from the airport.
By bus
The YARUCA bus stops right outside Jungle River Lodge and costs 40 Lps per person. To get from La Ceiba to Jungle River Lodge, go to the Terminal de Buses Principal San Jose and the bus will leave from there. If you are coming from the ferry, you can also get a taxi to take you to the "Desvio asl Cangejal" and get dropped by the Posta Policial and wait for the but to pass. A taxi from the ferry to here may costs between 100-200 Lps.
​
La Ceiba - Jungle River Lodge
Monday through, Saturday: 10:30 am, 12:30 pm and 3:00 pm
Sunday: one bus no schedule
​
To get from Jungle River Lodge to town, you have to hail the bus, which is easy as there is only one road. The bus will drop you off at the same bus station, from where you will have to take a taxi for between 150- 50 lempiras per person to the ferry terminal. Note, however, that the buses only stop when there are seats available and the time tables may differ.
​
Jungle River Lodge - La Ceiba
Monday to Saturday: 7:30 - 8:00 AM, 8:30 - 9:00 AM and 10:00 - 10:30 AM.
Sunday one bus, no schedule
By shuttle
Roneeys shuttle will bring you or pick you up from jungle River Lodge for $10 per person, minimum 2 persons. Select La Ceiba on their drop down menu and add the notes, Drop off Jungle River Lodge. Roneeys has routes to and from Nicaragua, Belize, El Salvador and Guatemala. You can find the timetable here on their website.
Hitchhiking
For adventurous travellers with a tight budget, there is still the option of hitchhiking. Many of our guests have already hitchhiked without any problems. However, keep in mind that you are still in Honduras. Pay attention to your surroundings and your own intuition. Chances are good to find someone who can at least get out of the jungle, because there is only one way out - it is only a matter of time.
​
Buses To and Out of La Ceiba
​
We recommended Transporte Cristina for travel to and from San Pedro Sula or Tegucigalpa. It is inexpensive and safe. The main bus terminal is where they Depart/Arrive in SPS and where you can connect with the Casasola Express (Copan). Heading to Copan, the last busses are: 1:00 and 3:00 pm so you need to get the 8:30 am Transporte Cristina out of La Ceiba. The El Mochito bus to D & D Brewery also connect in the SPS main bus terminal and heading to the lake, run every 1/2 hr until 5:00 pm
Please note: if you are coming from Copan, even if you take the 4 am departure and connect with the 11:15 am Transporte Cristina bus out of SPS. The trip from SPS to La Ceiba is 4.45 - 5.15 hrs long. so please be aware you will not get here early enough to catch the last local bus and therefore please ask us in advance to arrange transport and plan to have to pay for private transport. We do try to put travellers together to share the cost so ask us if anyone else is coming up.
